items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 121:1
items.html: (To the question) They are the four kinds of HaVaYaH mentioned above in Answer 248, in the aspect of the straight [order] within them. For the four letters of the HaVaYaH in the straight are the Keter of the face of ZA; and the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Alephin are the Hochma of the face of ZA; and the 28 letters of the filling of the filling of the HaVaYaH of Alephin are the Bina of the face of ZA; and the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Alephin are the HGT NHY of the face of ZA. And the aspect of the Gematrias of these four kinds of HaVaYaH are the nine Malchuts of the face of ZA.
